By way of the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of the case FIR, on consent.

The present case involves the allegation of offences under sections 376/366 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012; and section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 committed by one minor against another.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Respondent No.2 in the present matter is mother of the victim.
At the time of incident, the petitioner is stated to be about 17 years of age; and the victim was about 14 years and 10 months of age.
Both are now married; and they have a 3 year-old minor child.
This court is seized with the similar other matters, concerning on the question as to whether the FIR relating to inter-alia offences under POCSO can be quashed on consent.
This is a digitally signed order.
